reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the rrule-based daily weekend skip (via exrules), and consolidates the repeated recurConfigToRSchedule + new RSchedule construction into createRecurSchedule.

duplication.why: Removes three hand-built RSchedule constructions in favour of createRecurSchedule; the holiday rule is defined once for moving and once for daily skipping.

placement.why: Holiday logic lives in shared/schedules.ts beside recurConfigToRSchedule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; server callers just forward config.holidays.

scope.why: Only the holiday feature, the schedule-construction consolidation it needs, the type field and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear generalised walk over skipped days and one schedule factory, though every getDateWithSkippedWeekend caller must remember to pass holidays explicitly.

one_place.where: Moving past holidays is decided in getDateWithSkippedWeekend and daily holiday skipping in createRecurSchedule's exrules (shared/schedules.ts); getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, parseRecurDate and schedule-template all route through them.
